source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension (នាយកដ្ឋានផ្សព្វផ្សាយកសិកម្ម) - "ដំណាំក្រូចពោធិសាត់" (Pursat Orange Cultivation Guide), 2016, 26pp
text:
Before planting, farmers should evaluate the soil of the intended orchard site (ការជ្រើសរើសដី). The best soil for Pursat orange is deep, well-drained, and not prone to flooding, since standing water quickly damages the root system. A sandy loam soil is preferred, and the ideal soil pH is around 6.5.

Where irrigation is planned, it is common to lay out drip-line piping across the planting rows before or soon after planting, so that each tree can be watered evenly and efficiently as it establishes.
